thread:
maria-cs: Heads up — AcmeCorp pre-renewal came back with a handful of privacy + SOC2 items. They flagged data residency for embeddings and asked for DPA + KMS proof. Uploads due next week. Can legal/ops weigh in? cc @ashwin-custsec @tom-legal @kai-privacy
ashwin-custsec: Thanks — can you drop the exact questions? I want to triage into evidence vs product answers.
maria-cs: Pasted the customer's list: 1) Do you store embeddings outside region? 2) KMS BYOK options and key provenance? 3) Retention policy for embeddings and deletion flow? 4) SOC2 scope: do embeddings count as customer data in our scope? (they want the control mapping).
kai-privacy: For (1) we support regional hosting per tenant for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, we store embeddings in region of request — need to confirm which region Acme is using. @maria-cs what's their org id?
maria-cs: Org ID acme-123. They said EU only.
ashwin-custsec: Good — that implies hosted EU region. I'll pull logs to confirm no cross-border replication.
tom-legal: For KMS BYOK and key provenance: we have a BYOK flow for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted there's managed keys; we can provide KMS provider attestations and key rotation schedule. If they require HSM attestation, we need SOC2 supplement. @maria-cs do they specifically ask for HSM proof?
maria-cs: They asked 'key provenance and controls' and 'proof of HSM usage if available'. Not strict requirement yet, just asking.
olivia-ops: I'll assemble the Ops evidence pack. Can someone confirm where we keep the embeddings retention policy doc? I remember a PR in infra-docs.
kai-privacy: Retention policy is in Confluence under 'Data-Retention/Embeddings' — short link: https://confluence.internal/data-retention#embeddings. We'll need to redact internal emails.
ashwin-custsec: I'm going to run a quick query: `select count(*) from embeddings_meta where org='acme-123' and region!='eu'` — will post results.
deploy-bot: artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-evidence/acme-123/pre-renewal-2026-03-21.zip
maria-cs: Nice — can you also include the mapping doc that ties embeddings controls to SOC2 sections? Customer specifically asked for control IDs.
tom-legal: We have a mapping in this repo: git://legal/resources/soc2-mappings.md. I can export relevant sections.
ashwin-custsec: Query returned 0 — no cross-region embeddings. I'll attach the csv.
maria-cs: Attaching — `acme-region-check.csv` in the S3 bundle. @kai-privacy please review the retention text and sign off.
kai-privacy: Quick note — hosted EU retention is 90 days by default for embeddings. If Acme requests shorter, we can propose a data retention addendum but will need product signoff.
olivia-ops: Product: @sarah-product (not in thread) do we want to offer 30-day retention for renewals or keep standard?
maria-cs: Customer says they're looking for 30 days as an acceptable option. They called it a 'deal breaker' for renewal.
ashwin-custsec: Let's not promise until product OK. Meanwhile I'll prepare a 'what we can provide' email draft.
tom-legal: Draft quick DPA addendum options: (A) Standard 90-day, (B) 30-day retention w/ additional fees and addendum, (C) Dedicated deployment with tenant-controlled KMS. I'll draft language.
kai-privacy: I'll review DPA addendum and add the control mapping for embeddings deletion flows.
maria-cs: Thanks all. Timeline: need to get initial evidence packet to Acme by EOD Friday. Can we do that?
olivia-ops: Yes — I'll aim to upload redacted evidence by Thursday 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
ashwin-custsec: Email draft attached to S3 and PR: https://git.internal/cs/evidence/acme-123/pre-renewal-email.md
deploy-bot: Updated bundle: s3://redwood-evidence/acme-123/pre-renewal-2026-03-21-v2.zip
maria-cs: Perfect. I'll send the initial response once legal and privacy give the green light.
